# llm.txt — Arkadia Web Client

Guide for AI agents helping a user of this page — a browser-based client for
the Arkadia MUD. The UI is in Polish; labels below are quoted verbatim so you
can point the user at the right control.

All menus below are reached from the hamburger menu (`☰`) next to the command
input at the bottom of the page. Its entries are grouped under `Gra`,
`Ustawienia`, `Narzędzia` and `Wtyczki`; the field at the top of the menu
filters them.

---

## Create an alias
Path: `☰` → `Aliasy` → `Dodaj alias`.

- `Wzorzec (pattern)` is a **regular expression** matched against what the user
  types in the input box.
- Aliases are almost always anchored with `^` so they fire only when the line
  **starts** with that word. A typical pattern looks like `^zab (.+)$` — `^`
  means "start of line", then literal text, then a capture group.
- In the `Komenda` field use `$1`, `$2`, ... to reference capture groups.
- Object shortcuts `@1`, `@A`, `@@` expand to object IDs from the object list —
  useful in combat aliases.
- `$i` enables range expansion: pattern `^kok (.+)$` with command
  `rozerwij $i. kokon` lets the user type `kok 1-7` to run the command seven
  times.
- Each new line in the command runs as a separate command (same as `;`).
- Per-character overrides are available in the same modal.

## Create a trigger
Path: `☰` → `Triggery` → `Dodaj trigger`.

Two modes, chosen by radio button:
- `Wzorzec tekstu` — matches **game output** against a regex. Same regex
  semantics as aliases. Triggers often match mid-line, so leave `^` off unless
  the match really must be at line start. Flags (`i` case-insensitive, `g`
  global, `m` multiline) are set via the `Flagi` picker.
- `Zdarzenie` — fires on a client event instead of a text pattern.

Each trigger runs one or more `akcje`: color/replace/wrap the match, play a
sound, send a command, mute/unmute, etc. Plugin-provided actions appear grouped
by plugin.

## Bind a key
Path: `☰` → `Klawisze`.

A drawing of the keyboard with tabs for the modifier layers (`Bez
modyfikatora`, `Ctrl`, `Alt`/`⌥`, `Shift`, `Ctrl+Alt`); below it the bindings
grouped into `Podstawowe`, `Wrogowie`, `Tymczasowe`, `Kierunki` and `Własne`.
Click a key on the drawing, or a key next to a binding in the list and press the
new one. **Every change saves immediately — there is no `Zapisz` here.** Each
binding has one `Gdzie działa` setting (in the client / through the helper /
everywhere).

## Save a location shortcut or a note
Path: `☰` → `Miejsca`.

One window for both: a place is a map room with an optional shortcut name and an
optional note. `Tutaj` adds the room the user is standing in; the shortcut field
shows the matching `/prowadz nazwa` command; the note saves itself. The search
box finds rooms by name, area or number, so a place can be added without walking
there. Commands: `/dodaj_skrot id nazwa`, `/pokaz_skroty`, `/usun_skrot nazwa`,
`/prowadz nazwa`, `/note`.

## Change character settings (combat, herbs, collecting, language, ...)
Path: `☰` → `Postać`.

Per-character — stored under the currently logged-in character. The form is
disabled until a character is selected. Covers: compass/exits, containers,
coin/item collecting (with per-enemy overrides), combat commands, herbs,
`/dob` + `/op` slots, default language and language-switch aliases.

## Change interface / appearance / sound / buttons
Path: `☰` → `Interfejs` (the same `Ustawienia` window, opened on its `Interfejs`
group).

Global — shared across characters on this device. Pages: `Wygląd` (fonts,
colors, theme), `Okna` (`Menedżer Okien`, output window), `Komendy`,
`Przyciski` (on-screen buttons), `Przyciski mobilne` (mobile button grid),
`Menu kołowe` (mobile radial menu), `Stopka`, `Mapa`, `Dźwięk i powiadomienia`,
`Inne`. One `Zapisz` saves every page.

## Other menu entries worth knowing
- `Nagrania` — session recordings
- `Baza postaci` — known-players browser
- `Odbiorcy paczek` — package receivers
- `Kod QR lokacji` — QR code for the current room
- `Przyciski` / `Menu kołowe` — open `Ustawienia` on those pages
- `Eksport / import` — settings export and import
- `Skrypty (wtyczki)` — user scripts / plugins
- `Źródła danych` — downloaded game data
- `Helper` — the companion app (global hotkeys, window management)
- `Logi` — session logs
- `Dokumentacja` — built-in docs

---

## Layout Manager (`Menedżer Okien`)

Dockable/floating panels for map, conditions, chat and combat popups arranged
around the output area instead of overlaying it.

**It is on by default on desktop** (first visit from a big screen), together
with the on-screen buttons turned off, so there is usually nothing to suggest.
It stays off for users who declined the old offer, for mobile-like viewports,
and for anyone who switched it off afterwards.

If the user is on a desktop and does not have it on, it is worth offering:
1. `☰` → `Interfejs`.
2. Page `Okna`, section `Menedżer Okien` → tick `Włącz menedżer okien`.
   Optionally tick `Kondycje` to also dock the condition list.
3. Page `Przyciski mobilne` → **untick** `Pokaż przyciski na ekranie`
   (they only help on touch devices).
4. Press `Zapisz`.
